hints.sentence: Cell 4's collected gas is flat because the leachate that sped its decay also flooded its lower wells; the wells it did not flood show the faster decay.
Waste holds gas while the barometer rises and lets it out as it falls, and the campaigns only fly on settled days after fronts.
A cover oxidizes a nearly fixed amount per square metre, so the share it oxidizes falls as the flux through it rises.
